india.one_line: India advances AI models, regulation, industry growth, and seeks global partnerships.

themes.title: Chariot releases multilingual speech model
themes.text: Chariot launched Chariot‑1‑ASR Realtime, a speech‑to‑text system supporting ten Indian languages and Indian English, reporting lower error rates than competing systems across 79 public test sets.

stories.headline: Chariot launches real‑time speech model for 10 Indian languages

themes.title: India moves toward AI regulation
themes.text: The Indian government will draft a consultation paper on AI legislation in the coming weeks, and the securities regulator SEBI announced plans for a graded broker compliance framework, an AI sandbox for testing tools, and reforms for tokenised corporate bonds.

stories.headline: India to issue AI law consultation paper in coming weeks, says minister
SEBI to introduce graded broker compliance, AI sandbox, and corporate bond reforms

themes.title: Indian firms scale AI services
themes.text: Tech Mahindra partnered with SpaceXSI to offer AI‑assisted software engineering, LTM opened the BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab in Chennai for developing and validating AI solutions, and Infosys reported a 29% quarter‑on‑quarter rise in AI revenue while adjusting its FY27 growth outlook to 1‑2%.

stories.headline: Tech Mahindra partners with SpaceXSI to boost AI‑assisted software engineering
LTM launches BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab in Chennai
Infosys AI revenue rises 29% QoQ as FY27 growth guidance cut to 1-2%

themes.title: Poland seeks deeper AI ties with India
themes.text: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk called for stronger AI, digital and space cooperation with India, proposing joint development projects and inviting Indian firms to joint ventures at the Global Investors Meet 2027.

stories.headline: Polish prime minister calls for deeper AI, digital and space cooperation with India
